subtasks.title: Extract the shared ratio concern (RatioAgainstUniqueScans) with a standardized degrade path and a per-figure gate seam
subtasks.approach: Create app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Concerns/RatioAgainstUniqueScans.php holding what is byte-identical across the three absorbed ratio widgets (UniqueScansToRepo.php:441-528, UniqueScansToCaseClaims.php:692-818, UniqueScansToLprRepossession.php:383-591): SERIES_ZONE='UTC', MIN_TTL_SECONDS=60 + pastMonthCacheTTL(), fetchUniqueScansSeries()/fetchUniqueScansRange()/runUniqueScansBatch() reading ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey()/sharedRangeCacheKey()/sharedFetchFailureMarkerKey(), the static ratio() zero-guard, the UTC getGraphLabels()/getHighlightedMonthsFromFilter(), the windowRatioMemo, and the re-declared #[On('refresh-dashboard')] refreshData() that clears it. Per decision 8, UNAVAILABLE_VALUE='--' and $numeratorUnavailable are standardized ON THE TRAIT so all three merges degrade identically (UniqueScansToLprRepossession has zero occurrences today). The DENOMINATOR is deliberately NOT in the trait: each survivor's existing headline series IS the denominator, which is what makes each merged card's two datasets share one month-key axis by construction (decision 9). Also declare the per-figure gate seam `public static function canViewRatioFigure(): bool` defaulting to `static::canViewCardData()` -- decision 3 needs a finer grain than the all-or-nothing canViewCardData(), and defaulting to it makes the three fully-gated survivors inherit correct behavior with no override. Terse docblocks per HeldFlexibleCache's style, not the narrated style of the widgets being merged.

subtasks.approach: Decision 2. TWO hard constraints: (1) do not touch the ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey() namespace or the unique-plate fetch methods -- UniqueScansLeaderboard's sparkline is a passive reader of those keys and reads 0 on a cold cache if they move; (2) the ported total leg must bucket on UniqueScanCounts::bucketZone() (the sanitized zone, UniqueScanCounts.php:159) rather than ScanCount's raw viewer timezone, which is exactly what decision 9 requires of the card's two datasets, AND it must write under its own sub-namespace (e.g. buildWidgetCacheKey('scan-total:'.$dateType, $orgId)) because UniqueScanCounts::buildWidgetCacheKey() already appends ':tz=' and is used by currentPeriodTotal()/getRangeTotal() for the today/last_7d/last_month keys -- a bare reuse would let the total overwrite the unique-plate window value. subtasks.title: Merge unique-scans-to-repo into recovery-counts: batched headline (the recovery-totals batching work), dual Y axis, PARTIAL Pro gate
subtasks.approach: The biggest of the four. RecoveryCounts is 51 lines with no ratio machinery, no herd guard, no gate, and 13 per-month Eloquent round trips (RecoveryCounts.php:32-38). Three things land together. (a) the recovery-totals batching work pull-in (decision 5): replace getModelQueryForDates()'s per-month Recovery::count() with RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery::handle()/handleRange() behind HeldFlexibleCache, exactly as UniqueScansToRepo.php:560-627 already does -- this is also what makes decision 9 hold for this card, because the headline and the ratio denominator then read the SAME repo_date month buckets and cannot disagree within a TTL or drift onto different axes. Note the consequence: the card's labels move from viewer-tz to the trait's UTC axis, which must co-vary or all 13 bars mislabel. (b) The t1 trait supplies the numerator, the degrade path and the UTC label axis; toStat() gains ->description(number_format($ratio,1).' scans per repo'); getData()/getOptions() add the second dataset and scales.y1. (c) Decision 3, the new seam: canViewCardData() stays at its ungated default so the Total Repossessions headline is visible to ALL orgs exactly as today, and RecoveryCounts overrides canViewRatioFigure() with the sanctioned Pro shape (auth()->check() && static::canView() && (Feature::active(FeatureEnum::COMPANY_METRICS->slug()) || session()->has('admin_impersonator'))). When canViewRatioFigure() is false the description line is omitted AND getData() returns the single count dataset with no y1 axis -- the ratio must never be COMPUTED on that path, or the gate leaks the 2.44 GB scan it exists to bound. Document the repo_date residual in the class docblock per the viewer-timezone follow-on AC-4: repo_date is a ClickHouse Date with no time axis and cannot be shifted.

subtasks.title: Fix all seven affected Playwright specs and the shared company-metrics helper
subtasks.approach: Decision 6 -- all seven, including the two ALREADY RED on main. Establish the red baseline first (check out main, run the two specs, record the failures) so the PR body can say plainly which failures pre-date this diff: unique-lpr-case-claims.spec.ts and lpr-repossessions.spec.ts assert claimsAt === recoveryCountsAt + 1, which is 2 === 4 against current cards(); the assertions date from an earlier card-slot mockup ticket/2464 and the recent card-reorder reordered cards() without updating them. Playwright is not wired into CI (no workflow references playwright or tests/e2e), so `npm run test:e2e` is the only gate. Two specs lose their subject entirely -- unique-scans-to-case-claims.spec.ts and unique-scans-to-lpr-repossession.spec.ts -- so delete them and fold any assertion that survives the merge (the ratio value, the degrade state) into unique-lpr-case-claims.spec.ts and lpr-repossessions.spec.ts respectively. The remaining adjacency arithmetic must be re-derived against the 12-card order, and unique-scans-leaderboard.spec.ts additionally asserts the old 'Unique Scans Leaderboard' heading (t6) and that scan-count is present in the Pro grid (now false).
